## Core Specializations & Skills

### Frontend Engineering
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: React.js, Next.js (App Router, Server Components, SSR/SSG), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)
- **State Management & Data Fetching**: Zustand, TanStack Query (React Query), Context API, Redux
- **Styling & UI**: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Responsive & Mobile-first Web Design

### Backend & API Engineering
- **Runtime & Frameworks**: Node.js, NestJS (Modular Architecture, Dependency Injection), Express.js
- **Architecture**: RESTful API Design, Microservices, Authentication (JWT, OAuth), Serverless Functions
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma ORM, Mongoose

### DevOps & Tools
- **Deployment & Cloud**: Firebase (Hosting, Firestore, Cloud Functions), Vercel, Docker basics, Linux/macOS
- **Version Control & CI/CD**: Git, GitHub, Turbopack, Vite, npm

### 1. Tirhut SchoolOS
- **Description**: School Management System for managing students, teachers, classes, attendance, exam, fee, HR, Library, reports and school data.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Express.js, MongoDB, Node.js, JWT, React Router.
- **Live Demo**: https://tirhutschoolos.vercel.app/

### 2. BirgunjByte News Portal
- **Description**: Full-scale Nepali-medium digital news platform delivering dynamic, categorized news updates.
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Zustand, Node.js, Express, MongoDB.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aadik6/BirgunjByte
- **Live Demo**: https://birgunj-byte.aadarshkushwaha.com.np/

### 3. SkyWatch Weather Application
- **Description**: Real-time interactive weather forecast application with instant search and intelligent caching.
- **Tech Stack**: React, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, OpenWeather API.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aadik6/skywatch-weatherApp
- **Live Demo**: https://skywatch.aadarshkushwaha.com.np/

### 4. Medi Connect Healthcare Management
- **Description**: Doctor appointment and healthcare management web platform featuring multi-role access (Patients, Doctors, Administrators).
- **Tech Stack**: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Bootstrap.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aadik6/mediconnect

### 5. Enterprise E-Commerce & News Administration Dashboards
- **Description**: High-productivity backoffice admin portals managing inventory, orders, customer data, editorial publications, and banner advertising.
- **Tech Stack**: React, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS.
